sonnet.problem: The whole passage is mostly building plans (the temple's dimensions, rooms, materials and decoration), so it is a long stretch. This choice card asks about a count, the 480th year, which is not something the text says a thing is for, something someone says, or something that happens. It is also a pure discovery question the baker cannot reason out.
sonnet.rule: When the whole passage is a long stretch, each part gets its own summary card. Choice cards ask only about what the text says a thing is for, what someone says, anything that happens, and short stories inside it. Never about measurements, materials, counts or names.
